messages: anna: Dropping the latest compact-mode mock for the Usage dashboard. Focus areas: spend card density, token denomination contrast, and where to surface invoice CTAs. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/usage-compact-v3 :eyes: sam: Main UX trade: place scope control (org vs project) in the global header (single source) or allow per-card scope pills for side-by-side comparisons? Global is simpler; per-card supports quick comparisons but adds visual noise. jo: For compact rows I prefer a tiny scope pill (12-14px height) at the right edge of the card. If scopes differ across visible cards, show a subtle "mixed" badge at the top-left of the panel. Current full-width chips feel too heavy. devon: Heads-up: per-card scopes will cause multiple aggregation queries. We can batch them server-side but that requires backend work. Also rendering a sparkline per row on mobile is costly; consider canvas pooling. anna: To avoid blocking, proposal: initial rollout uses global header toggle. Add an "Advanced compare" toggle that switches to per-card pills without backend changes (client-only mock) so design + QA can validate flows. sam: Invoice CTA is too hidden as a tiny link. Suggest making it a subtle ghost button that surfaces invoice month + amount ("Invoice — Apr · $1.9K") to improve discoverability for finance folks. jo: Accessibility nit: the small grey token numbers don't pass AA on many backgrounds. Recommend switching to medium-weight text and using "Est. tokens" label. Add aria-labels for full exact numbers for screen readers. neil: Perf watch: hover expansion + ghost buttons must respect virtualization to avoid memory blowups on large orgs. Also client-side number formatting caused reflows in past builds. devon: Aria pattern I'll use in rows: ``` 💳 12.3k ``` Leaves visual compactness while giving SRs exact values. anna: Jo, please update mock with: 1) ghost invoice CTA variant, 2) compact scope pill option (advanced), 3) token contrast alternative. Devon: spin a small spike for canvas sparklines and batched endpoints. Neil: add infra note about request budget. Sam: validate CTA copy length on small widths. design-review-bot: Reminder: design review Friday 11:00am. Agenda: compact rollout, invoice affordance, accessibility fixes. jo: Will update and add an A/B artboard (global vs per-card) plus a contrast token variant. Will also show truncation at 320px. sam: Microcopy suggestion: "Est. tokens (total)" seems concise and clear for compact headers. anna: Ok, action items noted. We'll reconvene after mock updates. :+1:
